title: Projects Region / District test run
summary: End-to-end check of Region and District on Projects: the Sites step cascade and auto-fill, the Projects grid, search, sort and Excel export.
narrative: The first run had 2 failures, both from the tests themselves: a dropdown was closed with Escape, which also closed the wizard. After the fix the group was rerun and both passed. No failure pointed at the feature.

cases.checks: Sites step form returns Region, District, Site in that order
Site without Region / District gives blanks, no error
cases.reason: No such site among the sites scanned

cases.checks: Region narrows District, District narrows Site
Picking a Site fills Region / District
Changing Region resets District and Site

designedCases.checks: Field order in the Sites step form

findings.title: Each Projects list request takes about 45 seconds
findings.body: Every call to `/api/v1/projects/all` took roughly 45 seconds, with or without a keyword.
findings.evidence: Network timings in the C1 and C2 traces
findings.impact: Most of the suite's run time is spent waiting on it

findings.title: 3 sites cannot be reached through Region › District › Site
findings.body: These sites carry District 02B in their own record, but the District → Site relation does not link them.

findings.title: Escape closed the wizard along with the dropdown
findings.body: B2 and B3 pressed Escape to close a dropdown, which also closed the Add Project wizard.

fixes.change: Close the dropdown by clicking outside it
fixes.why: Keeps the wizard open for the next step

gaps: A2: no site without Region / District among the scanned sites.

rerun.auth: Sign in first so `e2e/.auth/user.json` is fresh.
